theory.title: Present and past passive voice
theory.explanation: Use am/is/are + past participle for the present passive and was/were + past participle for the past passive. The passive focuses on the action or result; add by + agent only when it matters.
theory.tip: Lee el contexto completo antes de elegir una forma. Comprueba el orden de las palabras y la intención del hablante.

content.passage: A message about the community event was sent to all residents on Monday. The meeting is organised by a small volunteer team, and the final programme is usually published online. Last year, several invitations were delivered late, so this time the addresses were checked carefully. Personal details are not shared with other organisations. If a change is made, an update is posted on the noticeboard and emailed to everyone. The event was created to bring neighbours together, and new volunteers are always welcomed.
